SELECT "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (schools.SOCType LIKE 'Continuation%'
       OR frpm."School Type" LIKE 'Continuation%'
       OR frpm."Educational Option Type" LIKE 'Continuation%')
  AND "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT s.dname AS District, AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda'
  AND schools.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.sname,
       sc.CharterNum,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS ranking
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T2.sname, T1.FundingType
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.cds
HAVING AVG(T2.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County LIKE '%Monterey%'
  AND s.EILCode = 'H'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_enrollment_diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > a.avg_enrollment_diff

SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT CAST("Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
       OR (AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
       OR (AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
)
SELECT AdmEmail1 FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" ASC LIMIT 1)

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', sch.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS average_writing_score, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" = (
      SELECT MAX(f2."Enrollment (K-12)")
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = 31
  )

SELECT s.MailStreet AS PostalStreet, s.School AS SchoolName
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT DISTINCT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE schools.Charter = '0' AND schools.County = 'Los Angeles' AND frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND date(OpenDate) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School,
       f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9'
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, f."Low Grade", s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT City, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
    FROM schools
    WHERE GSserved = 'K-8'
    GROUP BY City
),
magnet_multi AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS cnt
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Magnet = 1
      AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
      AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
)
SELECT 'magnet_k8_schools_with_multiple_provision_types' AS info, CAST(cnt AS TEXT) AS value
FROM magnet_multi
UNION ALL
SELECT 'number_of_cities_with_k8_schools', CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT)
FROM city_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT City, CAST(num_schools AS TEXT)
FROM city_counts

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, frpm.`District Code`
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR schools.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR schools.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND StatusType = 'Public'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) BETWEEN '2009' AND '2010'

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT posts.Title FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

SELECT p.AnswerCount FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND p.AnswerCount = (SELECT MAX(p2.AnswerCount) FROM posts p2 JOIN users u2 ON p2.OwnerUserId = u2.Id WHERE u2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie')

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie') AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011'
SELECT AVG(Score) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = 1910)
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ParentId = 107829 AND CommentCount = 1)

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title LIKE 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data%'
SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%'

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UserCount
FROM users u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Teacher')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Supporter')

SELECT ph.UserId,
       u.DisplayName
FROM postHistory ph
JOIN users u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
GROUP BY ph.UserId, u.DisplayName
HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT ph.PostId)
   AND MIN(u.Views) >= 1000

WITH TopCommenter AS (
    SELECT c.UserId, u.DisplayName, COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments c
    JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
    GROUP BY c.UserId, u.DisplayName
    ORDER BY CommentCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t.UserId, t.DisplayName, b.Name AS BadgeName, b.Date AS BadgeDate
FROM TopCommenter t
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = t.UserId

SELECT
  ph.PostHistoryTypeId AS post_history_type_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId)
   FROM comments c
   WHERE c.PostId = 3720) AS unique_comment_users
FROM postHistory ph
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720

SELECT posts.Score AS post_score, postLinks.LinkTypeId
FROM posts
JOIN postLinks ON posts.Id = postLinks.PostId
WHERE posts.Id = 395

WITH post_heavy_users AS (
    SELECT u.Id, u.UpVotes, u.Age
    FROM users u
    JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.UpVotes, u.Age
    HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10
)
SELECT SUM(UpVotes) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_up_votes,
       SUM(Age) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_age
FROM post_heavy_users
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Announcer'

SELECT DISTINCT b.Date
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location = 'Rochester, NY'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Teacher') * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges) AS teacher_badge_percentage

SELECT c.Text
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CreaionDate LIKE '2010-07-19 19:37:33%'

SELECT DISTINCT u.Age
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Sharpie'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010'

WITH votes_2010 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2010
  FROM votes
  WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010'
),
votes_2011 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2011
  FROM votes
  WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'
)
SELECT (SELECT cnt_2010 FROM votes_2010) * 1.0
     / (SELECT cnt_2011 FROM votes_2011) AS ratio

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName
FROM tags AS t
JOIN posts AS p
  ON p.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'John Salvatier')

WITH user_total_views AS (
    SELECT u.DisplayName, SUM(p.ViewCount) AS TotalViewCount
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
    GROUP BY u.DisplayName
)
SELECT DisplayName, TotalViewCount
FROM user_total_views
WHERE TotalViewCount = (SELECT MAX(TotalViewCount) FROM user_total_views)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Commentator' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2014'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2010-07-21 23:59:59'

SELECT DisplayName, Age
FROM users
WHERE Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users)

SELECT LastEditDate, LastEditorUserId
FROM posts
WHERE Title = 'Detecting a given face in a database of facial images'
SELECT Name FROM badges WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Location LIKE '%North Pole%') AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011'

SELECT users.DisplayName, users.WebsiteUrl
FROM users
JOIN posts ON users.Id = posts.OwnerUserId
WHERE posts.FavoriteCount > 150

SELECT p.Id,
       p.Title,
       p.LastEditDate,
       COUNT(ph.Id) AS PostHistoryCount
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'
GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title, p.LastEditDate

SELECT u.LastAccessDate, u.Location
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Outliers'

SELECT posts.Id, badges.Name
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Samuel'
  AND strftime('%Y', posts.CreaionDate) = '2013'
  AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2013'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000

SELECT OwnerUserId
FROM posts
WHERE FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts)

SELECT Id
FROM users
WHERE Age = (SELECT MIN(Age) FROM users)

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Name) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(CreationDate) FROM votes WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'chl')

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens'
  AND p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'

SELECT Id, Title
FROM posts
WHERE Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM posts)

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount > 20000
  AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > (SELECT AVG(ViewCount) FROM posts)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CommentCount
FROM comments
WHERE PostId = (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    ORDER BY Score DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > 35000 AND CommentCount = 0

WITH emmett AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE DisplayName = 'Emmett'
)
SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
WHERE b.UserId = (SELECT Id FROM emmett)
  AND b.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(b2.Date)
        FROM badges b2
        WHERE b2.UserId = (SELECT Id FROM emmett)
      )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 AND UpVotes > 5000

SELECT b.Name,
       b.Date,
       u.CreationDate,
       julianday(b.Date) - julianday(u.CreationDate) AS DifferenceInDays
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Zolomon'

SELECT c.Text, c.UserDisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts
WHERE Tags LIKE '%<careers>%'
SELECT Reputation, Views FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Jarrod Dixon'

WITH target_post AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title = 'Clustering 1D data'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM comments
     WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM target_post)) AS CommentCount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM posts
     WHERE ParentId = (SELECT Id FROM target_post)) AS AnswerCount

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM posts
WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE Id < 15 AND Count <= 20
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE Title LIKE '%linear regression%')

WITH ZeroScoreComments AS (
    SELECT c.Id AS CommentId, c.UserId
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.Score = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS UsersAged40
FROM ZeroScoreComments zsc
JOIN users u ON zsc.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Age = 40

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  AND u.DownVotes = 0

WITH total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM comments
    WHERE Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
),
zero_upvotes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM comments c
    JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
      AND u.UpVotes = 0
)
SELECT CAST(zero_upvotes.cnt AS REAL) * 100.0 / total.cnt AS percentage
FROM total, zero_upvotes

WITH LAMConsumption AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID, TotalConsumption
FROM LAMConsumption
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS KAMCustomerCount
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND t.TotalConsumption < 30000

SELECT c.Segment
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, annual_consumption
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment,
               CustomerID,
               annual_consumption,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY annual_consumption) AS rnk
        FROM czk_2013
    )
    WHERE rnk = 1
),
segment_avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(annual_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_annual_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_annual_consumption END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_annual_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
       MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_annual_consumption END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_annual_consumption END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
       MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_annual_consumption END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_annual_consumption END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avgs

SELECT ym.CustomerID
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND ym.Date = '201310'
ORDER BY ym.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date = 201305
  AND c.Segment = 'KAM'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
        FROM yearmonth y
        JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Consumption > 46.73) * 100.0
       /
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID)
        FROM customers
        WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS percentage
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM' AND Currency = 'EUR') * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS KAM_EUR_Percentage
SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

WITH eur_totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT MAX(TotalConsumption / 12.0) AS BiggestMonthlyConsumption
FROM eur_totals

SELECT p.Description
FROM products p
WHERE p.ProductID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.ProductID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.CustomerID IN (
        SELECT ym.CustomerID
        FROM yearmonth ym
        WHERE ym.Date LIKE '201309%'
    )
)
ORDER BY p.ProductID

SELECT DISTINCT Country
FROM gasstations
WHERE GasStationID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT GasStationID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 7) = '2013-06'
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ym.CustomerID
  FROM yearmonth ym
  WHERE ym.Consumption > 1000
    AND ym.CustomerID IN (
      SELECT CustomerID
      FROM customers
      WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
    )
)

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT Country
FROM gasstations
WHERE GasStationID = (
    SELECT GasStationID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
    ORDER BY Time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT Segment
FROM customers
WHERE CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    ORDER BY Date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '12:42:00'
SELECT Currency FROM customers WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth WHERE Consumption = 214582.17 AND Date LIKE '201306%')

SELECT Currency
FROM customers
WHERE CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-24' AND Price = 548.4
)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID)
        FROM transactions_1k t
        JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25' AND c.Currency = 'EUR') * 100.0
       /
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-25') AS percentage

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(Price) FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508) AS TotalAmountSpent,
  (SELECT SUM(Price) FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508 AND Date LIKE '201201%') AS January2012Spent

SELECT
    t.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Match m
JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id

WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE >= 1.5)

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p

WHERE p.SEX = 'M'

  AND l.ALB < 5.5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)

    SELECT COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM bond b
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '+'
),
carcinogenic_atoms AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
)
SELECT sb.bond_count * 1.0 / ca.atom_count AS average_single_bonds
FROM single_bonds sb, carcinogenic_atoms ca

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

FROM connected c

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m

WITH lead_atom AS (
    SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb'
)
SELECT atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM lead_atom)
UNION
SELECT atom_id
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM lead_atom)

WITH element_combinations AS (
    SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
),
max_combination AS (
    SELECT MAX(bond_count) AS max_bond_count
    FROM element_combinations
),
totals AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_bonds
    FROM bond
)
SELECT 100.0 * mc.max_bond_count / t.total_bonds AS max_combination_percentage
FROM max_combination mc
CROSS JOIN totals t

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS pct_single_bonds_carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (

    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT label

WITH bond_elements AS (
  SELECT a1.element AS element
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  UNION
  SELECT a2.element AS element
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
)
SELECT
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bond_elements WHERE element = 'cl')
  AND
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bond_elements WHERE element = 'c') AS has_both_cl_and_c

)

FROM molecule

SELECT molecule_id, atom_count
FROM (
    SELECT a.molecule_id AS molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id

    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (

        FROM atom a
        JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE m.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a.molecule_id

)

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_totals t
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T1."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX(T3."aCL IgA") FROM Examination AS T3 JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5)

SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT DISTINCT element

SELECT a.atom_id, a.element

JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2

SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN min_consumption m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avg;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T3.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND YEAR(p.`First Date`) < 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH = ( SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500 )
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 WHERE T1.ID IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5)

SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE < 1.5
  AND Examination.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '+'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(atom.element = 'c') / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id, bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
UNION
SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS e2,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY e1, e2
) t;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

GROUP BY atom.element;
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'ca')
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT bond.molecule_id
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND atom.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bonds,
       (SELECT molecule.label FROM molecule WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT count(*), T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T3.bond_id = T2.bond_id JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T4.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T4.label = 'TR346'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom AS a1 ON molecule.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON molecule.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T2.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM molecule
        JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
        WHERE molecule.label = '+'
        GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
    ) AS sub
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'

LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "CDSCode" FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.sname, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.CharterNum

JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.FundingType
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sa.cds IN (
    SELECT sa2.cds
    FROM satscores sa2
    JOIN schools s2 ON sa2.cds = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.County = 'Riverside'
    GROUP BY sa2.cds
    HAVING SUM(sa2.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(*) > 400
)

SELECT s."School", s."Street", s."City", s."State", s."Zip"
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'

  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM frpm AS T3
        JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
        WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT CAST(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)

SELECT T2.School, T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools AS T2
INNER JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.MailStreet, T2.sname FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY T2.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 AND T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus' AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11

GROUP BY County

SELECT `School Name`, `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` FROM `frpm` WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND `Low Grade` = 'K' AND `High Grade` = '9';
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, f.`Low Grade`, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS e2
    FROM connected c

    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT e1, e2, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY e1, e2
),
max_combo AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS m
    FROM combo_counts
)

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment, SUM(pc.total_consumption) AS total_lowest, COUNT(*) AS num_lowest
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN segment_min sm ON sm.Segment = pc.Segment AND sm.min_consumption = pc.total_consumption
    GROUP BY pc.Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_lowest * 1.0 / num_lowest AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    sme.annual_avg - lam.annual_avg AS diff_SME_LAM,
    lam.annual_avg - kam.annual_avg AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    kam.annual_avg - sme.annual_avg AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') sme
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') lam
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') kam;

            HAVING COUNT(at1.atom_id) = (
                SELECT MAX(g.cnt)

                    SELECT COUNT(a3.atom_id) AS cnt

        ) t

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.CustomerID END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.CustomerID END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.CustomerID END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.CustomerID END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.CustomerID END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.CustomerID END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.City,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_multi
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Magnet = 1
    AND s.GSoffered = 'K-8'
  GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.City
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(is_multi) AS num_multiple_provision,
         COUNT(DISTINCT City) AS num_cities
  FROM base
),
per_city AS (
  SELECT City, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
  FROM base
  GROUP BY City
)
SELECT t.num_multiple_provision,
       t.num_cities,
       p.City,
       p.num_schools
FROM totals t
CROSS JOIN per_city p;

INNER JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  AND u.DownVotes = 0;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN c.UserId END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.UserId) AS percentage_zero_upvotes
FROM comments c
LEFT JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, t.TotalConsumption
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    INNER JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
      AND c.Segment = 'LAM'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
) t
INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS kam_customers_under_30k
FROM (
    SELECT c.CustomerID
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(ym.Consumption) < 30000
) t;

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c
  ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CustTotal AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
MinTotal AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, Segment, TotalConsumption,
         MIN(TotalConsumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS MinTotal
  FROM CustTotal
),
Lowest AS (
  SELECT Segment, CustomerID, TotalConsumption
  FROM MinTotal
  WHERE TotalConsumption = MinTotal
),
AnnualAvg AS (
  SELECT Segment, SUM(TotalConsumption) / COUNT(CustomerID) AS AnnualAvgConsumption
  FROM Lowest
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM AnnualAvg;

SELECT c.CustomerID, y.Consumption
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'Euro'
  AND y.Date = 201310
  AND y.Consumption = (
      SELECT MAX(y2.Consumption)
      FROM customers c2
      JOIN yearmonth y2 ON c2.CustomerID = y2.CustomerID
      WHERE c2.Segment = 'LAM'
        AND c2.Currency = 'Euro'
        AND y2.Date = 201310
  );

SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date = 201305
  AND c.Segment = 'KAM';

SELECT 100.0 *
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN yearmonth.Consumption > 46.73
                           THEN yearmonth.CustomerID END)
     / COUNT(DISTINCT yearmonth.CustomerID) AS pct
FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers
  ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Segment = 'LAM';

SELECT MAX(TotalConsumption / 12) AS BiggestMonthlyConsumption
FROM (
  SELECT ym.CustomerID,
         SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c
    ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
) t;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c

SELECT g.Country

FROM yearmonth y

SELECT c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t

FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

SELECT SUM(Price) AS total_spent,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Date = '201201' THEN Price ELSE 0 END) AS spent_jan_2012
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508;

WITH TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t.CustomerID,
       c.Currency,
       SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM TopCustomer)
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

FROM Player_Attributes

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM (
    SELECT home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS loss_count
    FROM Match
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
      AND home_team_goal - away_team_goal < 0
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
    ORDER BY loss_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
) L
JOIN Team T ON L.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id;

FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (
      SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        AND overall_rating > (
            SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'));

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(ta2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(t2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
      JOIN Team AS t2 ON ta2.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', ta2.date) = '2012'
        AND ta2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT p.player_name,
       SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT SUM(chanceCreationPassing) * 1.0 / COUNT(id)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE vision > 89) pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m
  ON pa.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3,
      m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7,
      m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
      m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
      m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id;

SELECT country_name, avg_weight
FROM (
  SELECT c.name AS country_name, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
  FROM (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match WHERE home_player_2  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match WHERE home_player_3  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match WHERE home_player_4  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match WHERE home_player_5  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match WHERE home_player_6  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match WHERE home_player_7  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match WHERE home_player_8  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match WHERE home_player_9  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match WHERE home_player_10 IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match WHERE home_player_11 IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match WHERE away_player_1  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match WHERE away_player_2  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match WHERE away_player_3  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match WHERE away_player_4  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match WHERE away_player_5  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match WHERE away_player_6  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match WHERE away_player_7  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match WHERE away_player_8  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match WHERE away_player_9  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match WHERE away_player_10 IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
  ) AS pm
  JOIN Country c ON c.id = pm.country_id
  JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pm.player_api_id
  GROUP BY c.name
) AS t
ORDER BY avg_weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account
WHERE district_id IN (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'Prague'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loan
    WHERE loan.account_id = account.account_id
);

SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
       AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
       CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM client c
JOIN district d
  ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(client.client_id) AS male_count
FROM client
JOIN district
  ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000
  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT dp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
     - (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F') AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d3.A11)
               FROM client c3
               JOIN district d3 ON c3.district_id = d3.district_id
               WHERE c3.gender = 'F')
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c4.birth_date)
                      FROM client c4
                      JOIN district d4 ON c4.district_id = d4.district_id
                      WHERE c4.gender = 'F'
                        AND d4.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d5.A11)
                                      FROM client c5
                                      JOIN district d5 ON c5.district_id = d5.district_id
                                      WHERE c5.gender = 'F'));

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
        FROM loan l2
        JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
        WHERE l2.duration > 12
          AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           balance AS latest_balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY account_id
               ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM trans
) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.rn = 1
  AND t.latest_balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM account
JOIN trans
  ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.disp_id IN (
        SELECT c.disp_id
        FROM card c
        WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice')
  AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1996';

SELECT a.account_id,
       a.frequency,
       c.client_id,
       c.gender,

  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatients,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
         SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'more in-patients'
    ELSE 'more outpatients'
  END AS comparison,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

FROM Patient p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.RVVT = '+'
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB < 3.5
) AS low_alb ON p.ID = low_alb.ID;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200;

SELECT l.`Date`,
       strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS admission_age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
  ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(age_1999) AS avg_age_1999
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, 1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_1999
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
) t;

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT CASE p.SEX
         WHEN 'M' THEN 'man'
         WHEN 'F' THEN 'woman'
       END AS gender
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_test
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4'

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

);

SELECT ID,
       COUNT(ID) OVER () AS num_patients
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'

ORDER BY ID ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS final_patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID

  AND e.`aCL IgM` > (

SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS'

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS pct_female
FROM Patient

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND e.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND p.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'

SELECT CAST(julianday(MIN(e.`Examination Date`)) - julianday(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) AS avg_ldh FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT L.ID,
       L.Date,
       L.ALP,
       CASE WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE DATE(P.Birthday) = '1982-04-01';

SELECT p.ID,

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)

SELECT P.ID,

FROM Patient P

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS AvgUA
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) latest ON l.ID = latest.ID AND l.Date = latest.LatestDate
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS male_gt_female
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.SEX,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient
JOIN (

    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "T-BIL" >= 2.0
) AS Abnormal ON Patient.ID = Abnormal.ID
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, l.`T-CHO` AS tcho_value
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ID

WHERE e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory l

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS PatientCount
FROM Laboratory

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS num_patients

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID) AS FemaleNoSymptomCount

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID

  /

SELECT MAX(p.Birthday) AS youngest_birthday

SELECT MIN(p."First Date") AS first_recorded

SELECT `Date`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_normal_alb_tp

  AND L.ALB > 3.5 AND L.ALB < 5.5

SELECT MAX(e.ANA) AS highest_ANA

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID

JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory L

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.TG = (
    SELECT MAX(TG)
    FROM Laboratory

SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS chlorine_noncarc_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(bond.bond_id)
   FROM bond
   JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
   WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND bond.bond_type = '-') * 1.0

  (SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
   FROM atom

FROM atom a

      FROM bond

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

    SELECT c.atom_id2

);

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1, a1.element AS element1,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2, a2.element AS element2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent_carcinogenic
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND c.atom_id IS NOT NULL
  AND c.atom_id2 IS NOT NULL
  AND m.label = '-'

LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_id, b.bond_type
FROM bond b
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_type ASC, b.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id,
       molecule.label,
       CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top ON m.molecule_id = top.molecule_id;

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'
UNION
SELECT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+'
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(b.bond_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(b2.bond_id) AS cnt
        FROM bond b2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON b2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE b2.bond_type = ' = '
          AND m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY b2.molecule_id
    ) t
);

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
WHERE c.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb')
  AND c.atom_id2 NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb')
UNION
SELECT c.atom_id
FROM connected c
WHERE c.atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb')
  AND c.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb');

WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id, a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
), combos AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN element1 < element2 THEN element1 ELSE element2 END AS elem1,
           CASE WHEN element1 < element2 THEN element2 ELSE element1 END AS elem2,
           COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM pairs
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
), top_combo AS (
    SELECT SUM(bond_count) AS n
    FROM combos
    WHERE bond_count = (SELECT MAX(bond_count) FROM combos)
)
SELECT 100.0 * t.n / (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond) AS pct_top_combo
FROM top_combo t;

SELECT ROUND(
    (SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id)
     FROM bond b
     JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '+') * 100.0
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-'),
  5) AS pct_carcinogenic_single_bonds;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.bond_id

    SELECT bond_id, atom_id2 AS aid

    WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
) c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.aid

INTERSECT
SELECT c.bond_id

    WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
    UNION
    SELECT bond_id, atom_id2 AS aid
    FROM connected
    WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
) c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.aid
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT connected.atom_id AS first_atom, connected.atom_id2 AS second_atom
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id,

       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id,
       CASE m.label
         WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
         WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
         ELSE 'unknown'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,

FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_chlorine_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type)
        FROM bond b
        JOIN molecule m2 ON b.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = 'TR346') AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346';

SELECT m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS interpretation
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND m.molecule_id IN (
      SELECT a.molecule_id
      FROM atom a
      WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  );

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND m.molecule_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
      FROM atom a
      WHERE a.element = 'c'
  );

SELECT molecule_id
FROM bond
WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.atom_id IN ('TR000_2', 'TR000_4')
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) = 2
);

SELECT CASE element
         WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
         WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
         WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
         WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
         WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
         WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
         WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
         WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
         WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
         WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
         WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
         WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
         WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
         WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
         WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
         ELSE element
       END AS element_name
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
         WHEN label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
         ELSE 'unknown'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (

    FROM molecule m2
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
    WHERE m2.label = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_molecules

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules

JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'in-patient'

  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_in_percentage

WITH min_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON m.Segment = c.Segment AND m.min_consumption = y.Consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT c2.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Vampire'

FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler')
SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) FROM superhero
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
