SELECT T1.race FROM race AS T1 JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.race_id JOIN colour AS T3 ON T2.hair_colour_id = T3.id JOIN gender AS T4 ON T2.gender_id = T4.id WHERE T3.colour = 'blue' AND T4.gender = 'male'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2
SELECT ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'
SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown'
SELECT T1.weight_kg, T2.race FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T1.id = 40
SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Neutral'
SELECT T1.hero_id FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T3.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS deviation FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)
SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';
SELECT T2."aCL IgM" FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'
SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID = (SELECT T2.ID FROM Examination AS T2 WHERE T2."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE')
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.ANA = 'S' AND T2.`aCL IgM` > ( SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2 FROM Examination )
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT T1.Symptoms FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY T1.Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND T1.Admission = '-'

FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE p."ID" = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday LIKE '1982-04-01%' ORDER BY T2.Date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT L.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982' AND T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT L.ID, L.UA, P.SEX
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
    WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)
) T
WHERE (T.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (T.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5) > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5);
SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX

SELECT p.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (CAST(T2.FG AS REAL) NOT BETWEEN 150 AND 450)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" > 0 AND T2."U-PRO" < 30 AND T1."Diagnosis" = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(T2.CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND e.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID FROM Examination AS t1 JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE t1."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND t2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1."First Date") FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 WHERE T1.ID IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5)

SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T3."aCL IgA" = ( SELECT MAX(T4."aCL IgA") FROM Examination AS T4 JOIN Laboratory AS T5 ON T4.ID = T5.ID WHERE T5.CRE < 1.5 )

SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT CAST(SUM(element = 'c') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY atom.element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);
SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2 FROM connected JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND bond.bond_type = '#'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM (
    SELECT MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1, MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS e2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
) t
GROUP BY e1, e2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(m.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' OR molecule_id = 'TR001' OR molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT bond.bond_id, molecule.label FROM bond INNER JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY a.element
SELECT CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic' END FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(bond_type = ' = ') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id JOIN bond AS T2 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.label = 'TR346' GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2' INTERSECT SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY "Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)" ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT satscores.sname, satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.CharterNum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingRank
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T1.School, T1.FundingType
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T1.School
HAVING AVG(T2.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN seg_min m
      ON m.Segment = z.Segment
     AND m.MinConsumption = z.TotalConsumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')

SELECT SUM(PA.overall_rating) * 1.0 / COUNT(PA.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT DISTINCT PA.preferred_foot
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'

SELECT PA.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'

FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4,
                         M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8,
                         M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
                         M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4,
                         M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8,
                         M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C
  ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT c.name AS country
FROM match_players mp
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = mp.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND T1.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT AVG(A12) FROM district) > (SELECT AVG(A13) FROM district) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END;

FROM district d

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - MIN(d.A11) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
               FROM client c2
               JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
               WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                 AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'))
GROUP BY a.account_id

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1997' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan
WHERE strftime('%Y', loan.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp
    JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
    WHERE disp.account_id = loan.account_id
      AND client.gender = 'M'
  );

         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

         ELSE 'Outpatient'
       END AS more_group,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage

WHERE SEX = 'M';

WITH cust_tot AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_tot
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM cust_tot ct
    JOIN seg_min sm
      ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME's annual average - LAM's annual average",
    (SELECT annual_average FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average",
    (SELECT annual_average FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM's annual average - SME's annual average"
LIMIT 4;

-- Female clients only: gender = 'F' is the single row-level filter allowed
-- Age rule: if person A's birthdate > B's birthdate then B is older, so oldest = minimum birth_date
-- A11 is the average salary of the client's district, gap = max A11 over all districts minus the selected client A11
-- The ordering picks the oldest female client with the lowest A11 and the LIMIT keeps exactly one client row
SELECT dp.account_id AS account_number,
       MAX(dm.A11) - d.A11 AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
CROSS JOIN district dm
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY dp.account_id, d.A11, c.birth_date
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC, dp.account_id ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH combo AS (
    SELECT bond.bond_id AS bond_id,
           a1.atom_id   AS atom_id,
           a1.element   AS element1,
           a2.element   AS element2
    FROM bond
    JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT element1,
           element2,
           COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_cnt,
           COUNT(atom_id) AS atom_cnt
    FROM combo
    GROUP BY element1, element2
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT element1, element2
    FROM group_counts
    WHERE atom_cnt = (SELECT MAX(atom_cnt) FROM group_counts)
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(c.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.atom_id)
FROM combo c
JOIN qualifying q
  ON c.element1 = q.element1

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN c.CustomerID END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN c.CustomerID END) AS SME_LAM_diff,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN c.CustomerID END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN c.CustomerID END) AS LAM_KAM_diff,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN c.CustomerID END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN c.CustomerID END) AS KAM_SME_diff
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN yearmonth y
  ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM');

WITH lows AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Consumption) AS minc
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avgc AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS avc
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  JOIN lows l ON c.Segment = l.Segment AND y.Consumption = l.minc
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avc FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avc FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT avc FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avc FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT avc FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avc FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH bond_pairs AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS e2
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY c.bond_id
),
pair_counts AS (
    SELECT e1, e2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_pairs
    GROUP BY e1, e2
),
most_common AS (
    SELECT e1, e2
    FROM pair_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN bp.e1 = mc.e1 AND bp.e2 = mc.e2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

WITH min_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND y.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') / COUNT(SEX) * 100 FROM Patient WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND E.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND P.Admission = '-'
SELECT DATEDIFF(MIN(e.`Examination Date`), p.`First Date`) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
SELECT P.ID, CASE WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Albumin within normal range" FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(L1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS L1
JOIN Patient AS P ON L1.ID = P.ID
WHERE L1.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory AS L2 WHERE L2.ID = L1.ID)
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L1.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L1.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX
SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO` FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory) ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)
SELECT DISTINCT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30);
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0 AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND e.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2 AND L.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND YEAR(T1.`First Date`) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5 AND T2.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG = (SELECT MAX(TG) FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200))
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-');
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id LIMIT 2

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected c WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM connected AS c2
        JOIN atom AS a3 ON c2.atom_id = a3.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS a4 ON c2.atom_id2 = a4.atom_id
        GROUP BY MIN(a3.element, a4.element), MAX(a3.element, a4.element)
    )
)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(molecule.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' OR molecule_id = 'TR001' OR molecule_id = 'TR002'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT count(atom.element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
SELECT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(bond_type = ' = ') * 1.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+');
SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label AS carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl'
SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346' GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id JOIN bond ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT CAST("Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE "School Type" = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(st.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.sname, sc.FundingType
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.sname
HAVING SUM(s.AvgScrMath) * 1.0 / COUNT(s.cds) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND s.School LIKE '%High School%';

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE CDSCode IN (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
       OR (AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
       OR (AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
);

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores st ON sc.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE sc.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND (st.AvgScrRead + st.AvgScrMath + st.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / T1."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND date(OpenDate) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    "School Name",
    "FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND "High Grade" = '9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT City, GSoffered, School
FROM schools
WHERE State = 'CA'
ORDER BY Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City,
       COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
GROUP BY s.City;

SELECT f.`District Code`,
       f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND strftime('%m-%d-%Y', OpenDate) BETWEEN '01-01-2009' AND '12-31-2010'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND AdmEmail1 LIKE '%@%';

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count_2011
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT u.DisplayName AS Editor
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data';

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM users u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Teacher')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Supporter');

SELECT u.Id AS UserId, u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT ph.PostId);

SELECT b.UserId,
       u.DisplayName,
       b.Name AS BadgeName,
       b.Date AS BadgeDate
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE u.Id = (
    SELECT c.UserId
    FROM comments c
    GROUP BY c.UserId
    ORDER BY COUNT(c.Id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId)
        FROM comments c
        WHERE c.PostId = 3720) AS UniqueCommenters
FROM postHistory ph
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720;

SELECT p.Score, pl.LinkTypeId
FROM posts p
JOIN postLinks pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Id = 395;

SELECT SUM(UpVotes) / COUNT(Id) AS avg_upvotes,
       SUM(Age) / COUNT(Id) AS avg_age
FROM users
WHERE Id IN (
    SELECT OwnerUserId

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           y.Consumption AS Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(t.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_seg m
      ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND m.min_cons = t.Consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME - LAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM - KAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM - SME";

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'in-patient'
    ELSE 'outpatient'
  END AS more_group,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    2
  ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient

LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p."Diagnosis"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27'
  AND e."Diagnosis" = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.ANA = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND l.CRP > 2
  AND l.CRE = 1
  AND l.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Patient.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(e."Examination Date") - JULIANDAY(p."First Date") AS days_before_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298
ORDER BY e."Examination Date" ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALP,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE date(p.Birthday) = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T2.Date,
       CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_Normal
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
)
AND (
    (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'M') > SUM(SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
);

SELECT p.SEX,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS list
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT l.ID AS patient_id,
       l."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.APTT > 45
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."U-PRO" >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."U-PRO" > 0
  AND Laboratory."U-PRO" < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) 
FROM Examination e 
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID 
WHERE l.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT "ID"
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
  AND "SC170" IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.DNA < 8 AND p.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) AS Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P."First Date")
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT "Date"
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
  AND e."aCL IgA" = (
      SELECT MAX(e2."aCL IgA")
      FROM Examination e2
      JOIN Laboratory l2 ON e2.ID = l2.ID
      WHERE l2.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID 
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0 
  AND Examination."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM bond
        GROUP BY bond_type
    )
)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(connected.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN atom ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, a1.element AS atom1_element,
       c.atom_id2, a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT element
FROM (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
    GROUP BY element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS top_elements
ORDER BY element ASC;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top ON m.molecule_id = top.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT T3.element, T4.element
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T4 ON T2.atom_id2 = T4.atom_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND T1.bond_type = '#'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c
  ON (a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND c.atom_id = (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb'))
  OR (a.atom_id = c.atom_id AND c.atom_id2 = (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb'));

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element, a2.element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
);

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
      AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
           OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT c.atom_id AS first_atom, c.atom_id2 AS second_atom
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(T1.element)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
  AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carcinogenic_atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's')
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';
